newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Rambus up again after close.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Rambus up again after close.

text.p: Shares of Rambus Inc moved higher after the close Wednesday to 69, following a day of trading in which the semiconductor equipment maker's stock soared as high as 75 before closing at 67-3/4.
Earlier in the day the California-based company announced that about 750,000 of its shares had been released from lock-up restrictions related to its May 13 initial public offering.
Traders said few other shares were moving in the after- market, despite quarterly earnings released after the bell by companies such as Checkfree Corp and Intimate Brands Inc.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had volume of 2,100, compared with 11,800 Tuesday and session two had volume of 6.4 million, compared with 1.4 million.
